name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aerodynamics, sparked by watching F1 races late at night in his hometown of Shanghai. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before landing his first role as a junior data analyst for a Chinese touring car team. His meticulous approach and knack for identifying crucial performance indicators quickly propelled him through the ranks.

Wei's strategic philosophy revolves around a data-driven, yet adaptable approach. He believes in thoroughly understanding the car's limitations and maximizing its potential through innovative race strategies and real-time adjustments based on track conditions and competitor behavior. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to make quick, informed decisions, making him a highly sought-after strategist in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei has a focused gaze and a slender build.

quirks: Always carries a lucky abacus, though he never uses it.
Has a specific brand of green tea he must drink before every race.
Repeatedly clicks his pen when under pressure.
